= Data USA Poverty API filtered rows references 2015 Texas places =
DataUSA chart sources for race and gender values.
API full four-place female two-or-more row query: https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5&drilldowns=Place,Year,Race,Gender&measures=Poverty%20Population,Poverty%20Population%20Moe&include=Place:16000US4850256,16000US4845072,16000US4833212,16000US4837216;Poverty%20Status:0;Year:2015;Race:7;Gender:1
API alternative four places short: https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5&drilldowns=Place,Race,Gender,Year&measures=Poverty%20Population&include=Place:16000US4850256,16000US4845072,16000US4833212,16000US4837216;Poverty%20Status:0;Year:2015;Race:7;Gender:1
Nacogdoches filtered only: https://api.datausa.io/tesseract/data.jsonrecords?cube=acs_ygpsar_poverty_by_gender_age_race_5&drilldowns=Year,Race,Gender&measures=Poverty%20Population&include=Place:16000US4850256;Poverty%20Status:0;Year:2015;Race:7;Gender:1
